description: This file contains auxiliary functions for plotting data related to the instrument monitors in a space telescope project. The functions include polynomial regression, adding hover tools, limit boxes, data plotting with error bars, normalized data plotting, and setting up basic plot layouts. It leverages Bokeh for visualization, pandas for data handling, numpy for numerical operations, and astropy for time conversions.

methods.name: pol_regression(x, y, rank)
methods.description: Calculates polynomial regression of given rank for x and y data points.

methods.name: add_hover_tool(p, rend)
methods.description: Adds a hover tool to a Bokeh plot with specified tooltips.

methods.name: add_limit_box(p, lower, upper, alpha=0.1, color="green")
methods.description: Adds a colored box annotation to a Bokeh plot between specified limits.

methods.name: add_to_plot(p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, y_axis= "default", color="red", err='y')
methods.description: Adds scatter and line data to a plot with optional error bars, fetching data from a database.

methods.name: add_to_plot_normalized(p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, nominal, color="red")
methods.description: Adds normalized line and scatter plots to a Bokeh figure based on database data.

methods.name: add_basic_layout(p)
methods.description: Sets a standard aesthetic layout for a Bokeh plot including title, axes, and background.
